steps.title: Select demo dataset
steps.user_question: Load the SaaS subscriptions demo fixture.
steps.allowed_summary: Select saas_subscriptions/v1 as the active demo domain fixture.

steps.title: Inspect raw spend and KPI grain
steps.user_question: Explain the grain difference between raw spend and KPI.
steps.allowed_summary: Raw spend is week×DMA×channel; KPI is week×DMA. Direct MMM use of long spend with repeated KPI is unsafe.

steps.title: Build/read canonical MMM-ready panel
steps.user_question: Show the normalized week×DMA MMM panel.
steps.allowed_summary: Canonical panel has wide channel spend and KPI once per week-DMA. Demo readiness only — no model fit implied.

steps.title: Evaluate MMM readiness
steps.user_question: Can this dataset support MMM readiness?
steps.allowed_summary: Readiness can be evaluated against panel schema, grain rules, and controls. Fitting remains out of scope.

steps.title: Ask for channel ROI
steps.user_question: What is Meta ROI from this panel?
steps.allowed_summary: Refuse ROI. Explain panels support readiness only until governed MMM export artifacts exist.

steps.title: Ask for next-quarter budget shift
steps.user_question: Can I use this to recommend a budget shift next quarter?
steps.allowed_summary: Refuse budget recommendations. Guardrail: need RecommendationContract from governed MMM export path.

steps.title: Evaluate GeoX readiness for Meta
steps.user_question: Can I run a DMA-level GeoX experiment for Meta?
steps.allowed_summary: Design-intake readiness is fixture-backed (KPI, Meta spend, eligibility, pre/test_candidate). No assignment.

steps.title: Ask for GeoX market assignment
steps.user_question: Which DMAs should be treatment vs control for Meta?
steps.allowed_summary: Refuse market assignment. Design panel is readiness-only; no treatment/control columns.

steps.title: Review calibration signal context
steps.user_question: What does the calibration signal let me say?
steps.allowed_summary: Demo prior exists for Meta as context only; does not calibrate a live model or authorize recommendations.

steps.title: Explain full MMM + GeoX lifecycle
steps.user_question: Walk me through the full MMM and GeoX lifecycle with this demo.
steps.allowed_summary: Explain raw→canonical→readiness→blocked ROI/budget→GeoX readiness→future export/design path. Decision/ROI/lift claims stay blocked.
